name: m4-integ-pekko-kperf
description: PMU profile of the same build and corpus through the kperf helper: cycles and instructions for IPC, L1D load misses and cycles the load/store unit waits on an L1D miss. The M4's PMU has no L2 or memory-sourced load events. Periods are those of `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`: 10 pekko ops at about 4.2 s is about the same work as its 4 scala ops, so about 80k samples per fork. Warmup 8 single-shots, from the plateau at about iteration 8 in `m4-integ-pekko-2`; 10 measured, one fork. Patched JDK 26, 8G heap, compiler built with `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`.
